summary: Add local PostgreSQL services, explicit schema migrations and a private database for each test file cloned from a migrated template.
description: Add local Postgres development and test services, SQLAlchemy/Alembic integration for the FastAPI stacks (python-react and python-api), and explicit migration commands. The test harness clones a migrated template so each test file has a private database. Readiness checks distinguish API health from database availability. Product tables, queries and access rules are your work. Production hosting is separate, and migrations run as a release step rather than at application startup.
seoDescription: Postgres for FastAPI projects, with Docker Compose, SQLAlchemy, Alembic migrations and isolated databases for integration tests.

projectExamples.title: Persistent inventory workbench
projectExamples.description: Store custom equipment records through SQLAlchemy models and Alembic migrations. Build the API resources, screens and permissions on that foundation.

projectExamples.title: Import review database
projectExamples.description: Persist imported rows and review decisions in custom tables behind a FastAPI service. Use private test databases to exercise migrations and queries without touching development data.

plain.whatItIs: Adds a PostgreSQL database server to the Python and React app, with local test databases and recorded changes to its tables.
goodAt: Running the database on your own computer for development and tests
Making table changes through reviewed, saved steps
Giving each test file its own ready-made copy of the database
notGoodAt: Hosting a live production database; arrange a hosting provider separately.

requests: give my backend a local SQL database with persistent development data
isolate each test file's database without rebuilding its schema every time
manage schema changes through migrations and check them against my models
run a separate fast database service for tests
